known_baseline.interpretation: CRC32 of a zero-filled 256x240x4 byte RGBA buffer (61,440 bytes). This is the 'blank frame' hash produced when the PPU renders no visible output — i.e., the test ROM contains only a NOP sled with no graphics code executed.

verdict: NOT error-solidification. The blank-frame baseline is expected behaviour for minimal test ROMs (NOP sleds). The 12 non-nestest ROMs in tests/fixtures/ are generated by tests/fixtures/generate_test_roms.py and contain no game logic. nestest.nes is the only ROM with actual CPU/PPU activity, which is why it diverges from the blank-frame hash at frame 4.
